result.rationale: The migration in db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb does `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` with no guard for an empty result. Fresh installs and sites that never set embed_category would have no matching row, so `[0]` is nil and the migration raises NoMethodError. This is verifiable directly from the diff and is a deploy-blocking defect.

judged_text: The migration does `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` with no nil guard, so it crashes with NoMethodError on any install that never set the embed_category site setting. Every fresh install (and every existing install without embed_category configured) fails to run the migration, halting the deploy with `undefined method '[]' for nil:NilClass` — the schema for the new table never exists and all embed endpoints break.

adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration does `execute(... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category' )[0]['id']`. If the query returns no rows (e.g., `embed_category` was never present/set in `site_settings`), then `[0]` is `nil` and `['id']` raises `NoMethodError`. The later `if category_id == 0` fallback is unreachable in that case, so the migration can crash and halt deploys on instances without that setting row.
